headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when Mike Bailey competed under the AEW banner for the first time against The Beast Mortos, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.40 ? a well-worked match. Making his surprise AEW debut as the tournament's mystery wild card, "Speedball" Mike Bailey defeated The Beast Mortos with a spinning crescent kick.
It was 2025 when Cage & Dralistico touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.61.
